statement: Smooth isometric immersions of surfaces into ℝ<sup>4</sup>. Every closed smooth Riemannian surface admits a smooth isometric immersion into ℝ<sup>4</sup>, resolving the closed-surface form of the four-dimensional isometric-immersion problem. This includes nonorientable surfaces and metrics of arbitrary Gaussian curvature.
